newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Students turn up at Ivory Coast's main university in Abidjan's Cocody district to meet registration deadline despite strike called by student activisits to demand release of detained leaders and satisfaction on other grievances concerning grants, allowances and conditions; head of Cocody university, Hauhouot Asseypo, seeks campus security force.
- Student strike continues to bite in Abidjan; student federation FESCI rejects suggestions that it has conspired against government; secondary students in western town of Daloa join strike

- The Ivory Coast Federation of Autonomous Trades Unions FESACI, whose main members are close to the opposition, says privatisation threatens jobs; urges its members to mobilise to protect jobs in companies targeted for privatisation

- Panafrican conference in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan studies skin disease in the continent - Ivory Coast to host workshop on developing livestock in Sub-Saharan Africa from 18-22 February; Dakar-based inter-state school of veterinary science and medicine co-organises with Ivory Coast.
